================================================================================
bitpack stays usable as an identifier (pre-0.18 code)
================================================================================

const bitpack = 1;

fn bitpack(x: u32) u32 { return x; }

const z = bitpack(3);

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (variable_declaration
    (identifier)
    (integer))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameters
      (parameter
        name: (identifier)
        type: (builtin_type)))
    type: (builtin_type)
    body: (block
      (expression_statement
        (return_expression
          (identifier)))))
  (variable_declaration
    (identifier)
    (call_expression
      function: (identifier)
      arguments: (arguments
        (integer)))))
